'''Jeff McCarrol''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Arizona State Championship]] on 25 March 2000 with [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|CCT/Manipulator]], according to Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d396">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-27-az-states-who-gets-mized-worse-thand396/ az-states-who-gets-mized-worse-than], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 27 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-27-az-states-who-gets-mized-worse-thand396/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
